excluded_features: total transactions (including tnx to create contract)
score_percentile_reference: member-specific out-of-bag anomaly scores from bootstrap Isolation Forest ensemble
imputation: median learned from training data; fold-local for out-of-fold reference construction
warning: Anomaly percentiles and priority bands are not fraud probabilities or confirmed-fraud labels.
mu_definition: mean member-specific empirical anomaly percentile on [0, 1]; not fraud probability
sigma_squared_definition: sample variance (ddof=1) of member-specific empirical anomaly percentiles; bootstrap model disagreement, not fusion-calibrated predictive variance
next_calibration_stage: Requires compatible labelled fraud examples before mu can be interpreted as fraud probability; validate variance before inverse-variance weighting.
if_prediction_definition: Anomaly-priority band: ROUTINE, ELEVATED_ANOMALY, HIGH_ANOMALY, EXTREME_ANOMALY; not a fraud classification.

input_quality_status.PASS: No required model feature values are missing and no observed feature value is outside the model training min/max range.
input_quality_status.WARN: One or more feature values are missing and median-imputed, or one or more observed values lie outside training min/max. Outside-range can indicate a genuine anomaly, not necessarily bad input.
input_quality_status.UNUSABLE: All 20 required feature values are missing; numeric anomaly outputs are suppressed and if_prediction is NOT_SCORED_INPUT_UNUSABLE.

raw_live_preprocessing.column_name_normalization: Trim surrounding whitespace; reject duplicate columns after normalization.
raw_live_preprocessing.missing_values: Preserved through preprocessing so inference can flag and impute them; invalid text/infinite values are rejected.

distribution_shift_note: Dataset audit reports per-feature missingness, training range exceedance, quantiles, and a transparent heuristic warning. It is not a calibrated statistical drift test.

live_input_audit_defaults.interpretation: Engineering review heuristics, not statistically calibrated drift tests.
